capabilityChanges.effect: Does not change the accepted L1 covenant proof or payload state already in this repo.
Adds a based-rollup scouting lane for endpoints, bridge model, tooling, wallet path, and one tiny app.
Can support richer state machines, EVM-style app logic, stable-value flows, and DeFi prototypes around L1 settlement.
Building our own rollup stack is a separate infrastructure project; first build on or study an available stack.

nextActions.detail: Locate the public PoC branch/book, vProgs repo, and any available rollup endpoints or demos.
Map entry, transfer, exit, claim/outbox, proof verification, and state-root update responsibilities.
Pick one small app that can compare L1 covenant settlement against rollup execution state.
Keep current TN12 L1 covenant work moving while rollup scouting stays separate.
Do not depend on Igra, Kasplex, or any L2 for current repo proofs, custody work, wallet submit, or accepted-state indexing.
If core or core-adjacent work provides a based rollup path that is explicitly migratable to vProgs, evaluate it as a future deployment lane.
